answer: To stop Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, each agent locks $50,000 in liquid collateral. Second, the local hardware enclave generates a unique, unforgeable identity proof. Third, validators confirm the hardware's integrity via a secure, decentralized registry. This reaches the zenith of defense. An attacker must spend $50,000 per fake node and endure 20 days of verification. Just as a yarrow plant survives harsh winds, this protocol hardens the network. Like a lotus blooming through heavy silt, only high-cost agents survive the flood.
